svg.text: Paata — breadboard layout (830-point board, top view)
Numbers are breadboard rows, letters are columns. Every wire end sits in the hole shown; board outlines are approximate.
Dashed tags at the top: plug the loose end of that wire into the hole below the tag.
Pads 14, 15, 16 on the ESP32 board do not reach the breadboard: solder a wire to each.
Power comes from USB. The power rails, 5V pin, battery and charger are not used.
